The North Star (SN-3160) is the standard; the army is the hands that build to it — and hands that don't understand the design law can't build to it, no matter how fast they move. His instruction is to empower them NOW, not someday: if it can be done now, it is done now. An agent that fully understands what everything is supposed to work like and function like creates with thought, care, attention and detail — the same words as the standard itself — because understanding is what turns speed into quality. A Naya who has not read the training has not started: the training is the gate, and the gate is the North Star first.
